Online it’s easy to pretend to be someone else. Here are the signs to watch for.

Dopo qualche settimana Fede gli regala d: After a few weeks Fede gives him some in-game credits. Then Fede asks him to move to another app, “more private”, and not to tell anyone.

<span class=\"pp-choice__letter\" aria-h: A The gifts: Fede is a bit too nice.
Anche i regali sono un segnale, ma il pi: Gifts are a sign too, but the strongest one comes next: the request for secrecy.
<span class=\"pp-choice__letter\" aria-h: B The secrecy and the move to a private chat.

Se sta succedendo a te: If this is happening to you
Succede a tante persone e non è colpa tu: It happens to lots of people and it’s not your fault. You can call at any time, or open Get help now.
Scegli il livello: la verità è la stessa: Pick your level: the truth is the same, only the words change.
Online ci sono anche persone che dicono: Online there are also people who lie about who they are. If someone you don’t know messages you, asks for a photo or asks you to keep a secret, tell a grown-up straight away.
Non ti sgrida nessuno: hai fatto la cosa: Nobody will be cross with you: you did the right thing.
Chi vuole approfittarsi di un ragazzo pu: Someone who wants to take advantage of a young person may pretend to be the same age, give gifts and ask for secrets.
Se qualcuno ti chiede foto, segreti o di: If someone asks you for photos, secrets or to meet in person, stop and talk to an adult you trust.
Se ti ricattano con una foto: non pagare: If someone blackmails you with a photo: don’t pay, don’t delete the chat, keep the evidence and ask for help. It’s not your fault.
<strong>Adescamento.</strong> Chi adesca: Grooming. Groomers may pretend to be younger, give gifts and move the conversation to private or encrypted apps. In 2025 Italy’s Polizia Postale handled 428 online grooming cases, 174 with victims aged 10 to 13.
<strong>Sextortion.</strong> È il ricatt: Sextortion. It’s blackmail using intimate images: in 2025 there were 220 cases with minor victims in Italy, 87% aged 14 to 17. Police advise not paying, not deleting messages, keeping evidence and reporting it (in Italy at commissariatodips.it). In Italy, from 14 you can ask the Data Protection Authority to block the images from spreading. For photos and videos taken before you were 18 there is also Take It Down, a free international service: the file stays on your phone and only its digital fingerprint is sent.
Prendi il telefono: lo facciamo insieme,: Grab your phone: let’s do it together, right now.
Scegli un adulto di cui ti fidi, a cui r: Pick an adult you trust, someone you’d tell anything.
Salva in rubrica il 114 e il 1.96.96 di: If you live in Italy, save 114 and Telefono Azzurro’s 1.96.96 in your contacts; elsewhere, save your country’s child helpline.
Controlla chi può scriverti in privato s: Check who can message you privately on social media and in games: friends only is best.
Seleziona tutti i segnali d’allarme, poi: Select all the warning signs, then check.
«Non dirlo ai tuoi genitori, è un segret: “Don’t tell your parents, it’s our secret.”
<strong>Trappola.</strong> Chiedere segr: Trap. Asking for secrets is a way to cut you off from the people who can help you.
«Mandami una foto, solo per me.»: “Send me a photo, just for me.”
<strong>Trappola.</strong> Una foto invi: Trap. A photo once sent can’t be taken back, and it can become blackmail.
«Ti regalo dei crediti se passi su un’al: “I’ll give you credits if you move to another app.”
<strong>Trappola.</strong> Regali e chat: Trap. Gifts and private chats are ways to gain your trust and isolate you.
«Quanti anni hai? In che scuola vai?»: “How old are you? Which school do you go to?”
<strong>Trappola.</strong> Da uno sconos: Trap. From a stranger, questions like these are about finding out who you are and where to find you.
